description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects the trailing-slash AWS token route used by the documented authentication bypass.
affected_versions: jfrog artifactory: 0 to <7.111.20, 7.117.0 to <7.117.27, 7.125.0 to <7.125.19, 7.133.0 to <7.133.28, 7.146.0 to <7.146.8; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects the trailing-slash AWS token route used by the documented authentication bypass.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Clients intentionally using the trailing-slash token route must switch to the canonical route or a trusted policy.
